_guide.cv: 把英文 CV PDF 放到 assets 文件夹后，将 links.cv.href 改成真实文件路径，例如 assets/Pan-Hu-CV.pdf。
_guide.externalLinks: Ertha Home、Instagram、LinkedIn 都使用真实外链。发布前请手动点击测试。

image.alt: Ertha Home SEO and GEO workflow covering technical audit, keyword research, on-page optimisation and search monitoring
image.caption: SEO / GEO & Content

content.overview: Built and implemented an end-to-end SEO strategy for Ertha Home, covering technical SEO, competitor and keyword research, on-page optimisation, and ongoing performance monitoring.

contributions.title: 01 - Technical SEO
contributions.body: Used **Google Search Console** and **SEO crawler tools** to audit and improve crawlability, indexability, site structure, redirects, and page performance, with **123 priority pages** successfully indexed by Google.

contributions.title: 02 - Competitive & Keyword Research
contributions.body: Used **Google Keyword Planner** and **AI-assisted research tools** to research keywords and analyse **50+ competitor websites**, identifying relevant keywords and search intent, with the site appearing across **93 Google search queries**.

contributions.title: 03 - On-page SEO
contributions.body: Optimised on-page SEO across a **Shopify catalogue of 100+ SKUs**, including titles, headings, product and collection content, image alt text, and internal linking, contributing to a **477% increase in Google Search impressions**.

contributions.title: 04 - Monitoring & Iteration
contributions.body: Monitored SEO performance through **Google Search Console**, using search data to guide ongoing optimisation, with organic clicks up **15% compared with the previous 28-day period**.

image.alt: Instagram content overview and performance analytics for Ertha Home
image.caption: Content & Social Media

content.overview: Built Ertha Home's Instagram presence from scratch, developing an organic content strategy focused on visual storytelling, audience growth, and product discovery.

contributions.title: 01 - Content Strategy
contributions.body: Developed a consistent content strategy around Ertha Home's collection themes, product storytelling, and audience response, using performance insights to refine content formats and topics.

contributions.title: 02 - Organic Audience Growth
contributions.body: Grew the account from zero by **6,000+ followers in the first month**, reaching **8.3K total followers and 716K+ views**, with **87.6% of views coming from non-followers**.

contributions.title: 03 - Viral Content & Creative Testing
contributions.body: Produced **multiple high-performing posts and Reels** through ongoing creative testing, including content reaching **340K and 190K views**, with the top-performing Reel generating **31.2K interactions**.

contributions.title: 04 - Traffic & Optimisation
contributions.body: Used **Instagram Insights** and **Meta Business Suite** to analyse audience and content performance, generating **2,494 external link taps** and **13K+ profile visits** while guiding ongoing optimisation.

image.alt: Ertha Home US ceramics market research summary covering search demand, consumer reviews, competitor benchmarking and reporting

content.overview: Conducted data-led market research to understand market demand, consumer needs and the competitive landscape of the US ceramics market.

contributions.title: 01 — Market Research
contributions.body: Used **Google Keyword Planner** and **Google Trends** to analyse **200+ search terms**, identifying category demand, search trends and market opportunities in the US.

contributions.title: 02 — Consumer Insights
contributions.body: Used **Python** and **AI-assisted workflows** to analyse **500+ consumer reviews** from Reddit, Etsy and other platforms, identifying recurring needs, preferences and pain points.

contributions.title: 03 — Competitor Analysis
contributions.body: Used **Semrush** to benchmark **50+ competitors** across website traffic, search visibility and market positioning.

contributions.title: 04 — Data Visualisation & Reporting
contributions.body: Used **AI-assisted workflows** and **Excel** to clean, structure and visualise research data, producing an independent market research report with key findings and recommendations.

image.alt: Ertha Home Shopify storefront shown across laptop, tablet and mobile devices

content.overview: Designed and built the Ertha Home Shopify storefront from scratch, covering website design, CMS setup, catalogue structure, responsive optimisation, and pre-launch QA.

contributions.title: 01 - Website & Visual Design
contributions.body: Used **Canva** and **AI-assisted design workflows** to develop the website's visual direction, page layouts, banners, and product assets, ensuring a consistent visual identity across the storefront.

contributions.title: 02 - Shopify CMS & Page Build
contributions.body: Built and managed **30+ storefront pages** through **Shopify CMS**, including homepage, collection, FAQ, contact, brand content, and policy pages, creating a complete e-commerce storefront from scratch.

contributions.title: 03 - Catalogue & Site Structure
contributions.body: Structured and managed **100+ SKUs** across product types and collections, creating clear navigation and browsing paths to make products easier for customers to discover.

contributions.title: 04 - Responsive QA & Launch
contributions.body: Tested the storefront across **desktop and mobile**, reviewing navigation, layouts, product listings, and purchase flows, while preparing the store to support customers across **30+ international markets**.

image.alt: MEI PI QI circular bayberry brand logo centred on a white background
MEI PI QI consumer insights, competitor landscape and brand direction research summary

content.overview: Conducted consumer and competitor research to understand category perceptions, identify market opportunities, and define the strategic direction for the rebrand.

contributions.title: 01 — Consumer & Keyword Research
contributions.body: Used **Python-based** word-frequency analysis and visualisation to analyse **572 e-commerce beverage reviews**, identifying key consumer concerns, preferences, and category language.

contributions.title: 02 — Competitor Research
contributions.body: Used **Semrush and competitor website analysis** to evaluate competitor positioning, messaging, visual identity, and digital presence, identifying opportunities for brand differentiation.

contributions.title: 03 — Brand Positioning
contributions.body: Synthesised consumer and competitor insights to define the brand’s positioning, personality, key messaging, and creative direction for the rebrand.

image.alt: MEI PI QI brand identity, IP character development and packaging strategy

content.overview: Led the visual and packaging direction for the rebrand, translating brand positioning into clear creative decisions for younger consumers and different usage scenarios.

contributions.title: 01 — Brand Identity Direction
contributions.body: Defined the brand’s **core visual direction and identity principles**, establishing how the brand should look and feel across packaging, content, and offline touchpoints.

contributions.title: 02 — IP Concept & Art Direction
contributions.body: Defined the **IP concept and creative direction**, combining traditional Chinese opera-inspired elements with bayberry cues to shape a distinctive character for Gen Z audiences.

contributions.title: 03 — Packaging Design
contributions.body: Defined a **scenario-based packaging strategy** for outdoor, gifting, and office/study use, selecting formats and materials based on different consumer needs.

image.alt: MEI PI QI pop-up experience, IP merchandise and online-to-offline engagement campaign

content.overview: Developed a pop-up activation strategy to bring the rebranded identity into physical experiences and strengthen engagement with younger consumers.

contributions.title: 01 — Pop-up Experience
contributions.body: Planned a **two-channel store + pop-up activation model**, combining themed offline experiences with social media promotion to drive product discovery, sampling, and sharing.

contributions.title: 02 — IP Merchandise
contributions.body: Defined **10+** merchandise categories, including apparel, accessories, collectibles, and lifestyle products, extending the brand beyond beverages and into lifestyle touchpoints.

contributions.title: 03 — Online-to-Offline Engagement
contributions.body: Defined an **online-to-offline engagement model** using QR codes, points-based rewards, check-ins, and social sharing, achieving an approximately **25%** visitor-to-member conversion rate.
